name: moses
description: The ten commandments, delivered by hooks to every session and sub-agent, plus the procedures and agents that carry them out

operator_name.title: Your name
operator_name.description: Who the commandments belong to, and who the handoff gate protects. Leave blank for "the operator".

house_style.title: House style
house_style.description: A convention that rides along with the rules, such as "US English everywhere — color, behavior, center." Leave blank for none.

commandments_file.title: Your commandments file
commandments_file.description: Absolute path to your own copy of the rules. Blank uses <memory>/project_moses.md if it exists, else the framework's docs/COMMANDMENTS.md.

memory_dir.title: Memory directory
memory_dir.description: Absolute path to the memory corpus. Blank means ~/.claude/memory.

moses_home.title: Moses checkout
moses_home.description: Absolute path to the running Moses tree, for the drift check at session start. Blank means ~/Projects/moses.
